newsitem.title: USA: Pronet in talks about potential combination.
newsitem.headline: Pronet in talks about potential combination.

text.p: Pronet Inc said Tuesday it is in talks with a third party regarding a potential strategic combination.
If the board approves the deal, the company said a definitive agreement would be subject to resolving certain remaining issues and approval by the potential partner's board.
The company did not disclose the name of the third party.

Pronet said there can be no assurance a definitive agreement will be entered into, or that if any transaction occurs, the consideration to be received by its stockholders would equal or exceed current market prices.
The company's stock closed Monday at 5 7/16.
